summary: DevvStream Corp. filed an 8-K on September 21, 2026, reporting a First Amendment to a June 30, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement with EEME Energy SPV I LLC and Southern Energy Renewables. EEME had agreed to buy $1.0M of shares at $0.28683, but paid only $161K. The amendment cancels 2,925,078 shares, retains 561,308, and requires an added $200K by September 29, 2026, for 1,120,448 shares at $0.1785. All further funding, including $5.0M in advances, is terminated.
